Privacy

The explorer has no account system, analytics, advertising or submission backend. Its JavaScript keeps display preferences in your browser and puts selected records/filters in the page URL so views can be shared. Current-view downloads are created in your browser.

GitHub Pages hosts the site and processes requests under GitHub's privacy statement. Opening source links takes you to the source publisher or the Internet Archive, with their own policies.

Contributions, questions and contact go through public GitHub issues and pull requests. Those submissions are visible publicly. This project has no confidential tip channel.

The dataset describes public roles and sourced public-interest records. It does not publish contributor home addresses, personal contact lists, credentials or private files. To raise a record-specific concern, use the correction form with a public record ID and the minimum information needed to explain it.
